items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1962-09-19
items.q: we used to play Overtures, William Tells, When the Picture Finished.

ctx.x: Now you switched from the corner to the trumpet a long time ago, didn't you?

Yeah. In 1925. That's because I was playing in a symphony orchestra in 1925 in Chicago for silent pictures. And we used to play Overtures, William Tells, When the Picture Finished. Then after that we played Hot Number. And after that I was there for it, but still in all I had to learn how to play all the classics.
So you're a good sight reader too.
